template.filename: Trading Account Application Form - Individual V.February 2025(3).pdf

before_live_integration: Replace/resolve source.actual_das_field_id only after matching installed CustomerProfileSchema, related collections and enums
Render 1-page synthetic fixture with debug overlays; visually inspect and calibrate positions especially text fields and table rectangles
Verify every checkbox lands inside official square and every char stays in its cell
Require staff review of any overflow, ambiguous choice, absent required data, and output PDF preview
Keep original 14-page PDF and store template hash and customer snapshot/revision
source_data_ownership: primary applicant not equal to spouse or next of kin
never auto-confirm tax declarations, verification, signatures, office-only approvals

selection_predicate_convention.checkbox: mark only when verified enum or multiselect contains the printed option after Codex maps enum values
selection_predicate_convention.boolean_choices: mark yes or no only when value explicitly answered, otherwise both blank
selection_predicate_convention.enum_choice: mark exactly one chosen option unless source supports multi-select

renderers.recommended: FPDI plus FPDF/TCPDF or installed equivalent
renderers.coordinate_conversion: If library origin is bottom-left, y_bottom = page_height_pt - y_top - element_height
renderers.reference: Measurements use PyMuPDF visible-page top-left coordinates

runtime_contract.manual_cells: field positions may be mapped for reference but should_autofill=false is authoritative
